min_renderer_version.description: Minimum renderer version required to render this scene

profiles.description: Named composition variants (e.g. portrait, square, 4k) selectable via --composition <name>

fonts.description: Font file paths (.ttf/.otf). Empty = fallback to system sans-serif.

layers.description: Back-to-front z-order; root layers use absolute canvas coordinates.

expr.description: Mathematical expression evaluated per frame (e.g. 'sin(t*2.0)*50 + val')

bezier.description: Control points [x1, y1, x2, y2] for cubic_bezier easing

repeat.description: Number of animation cycle repeats or infinite

yoyo.description: If true, odd cycles reverse direction (to -> from)

duration_secs.description: Layer duration (alternative to end_sec = start_sec + duration_secs)

overlap_secs.description: Backward overlap in container timeline series mode

scale_y.description: Vertical scale multiplier composed with scale

pivot_x.description: Normalized horizontal transform pivot (0 = left, 1 = right)

pivot_y.description: Normalized vertical transform pivot (0 = top, 1 = bottom)

clip.description: If true, children are clipped to container bounds and radius (overflow: hidden)

clip_feather.description: Soften the clip mask edge by this many pixels (requires clip=true)

cascade_opacity.description: If true, container opacity multiplies into children

timeline.description: global = canvas time; local = relative to container start_sec; series = sequential children

stagger_secs.description: Progressive delay between children in seconds

backface_visible.description: Cull the layer when it faces away from the camera
